title: Forms of LLM-Integrated Applications from LLM-Chats to Autonomous AI Agent System

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent. Whether these labels denote genuine architectural forms or serve as branding has not been assessed systematically.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地作为组件嵌入软件系统中，并以聊天机器人、副驾驶、检索增强生成、工作流、编码智能体和 AI 智能体等标签进行推广。 这些标签究竟代表真正的架构形式，还是仅用于品牌宣传，目前尚未得到系统性的评估。

sents.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent.

paragraphs.en: In the sources surveyed, labels do carry architectural content, most clearly in vendor usage: copilot denotes a router-worker architecture operating a host application under step-by-step user confirmation, while the more recent shift to the label agent coincides with AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The coding agents of four major providers share one architecture, a reason-and-act loop delegating to subagents.
paragraphs.zh: 在调查的资料中，标签确实包含架构相关内容，最明显的体现是供应商的使用方式：“copilot”指代一种路由器-工作者架构，该架构在用户的逐步确认下运行主机应用程序；而近期转向使用“agent”这一标签，则与由人工智能规划的多步骤执行相吻合，用户仅能看到最终结果。 四大主要提供商的编码智能体共享相同的架构，即一个将任务委托给子智能体的“推理-行动”循环。

paragraphs.en: This survey describes seven recurring forms—LLM chats, custom agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-enhanced workflows, copilots, coding agents, and, in part, agentic RAG—in a common vocabulary of agents and tools. Each is characterized along four structural dimensions (agentic RAG only partially): the architectural pattern, the control of execution and the point of user intervention, the number of agent calls per task, and tool use. An illustrative corpus of 22 systems from research publications and vendor documentation grounds the descriptions and shows where they reach their limit.
paragraphs.zh: 本综述在智能体与工具的通用术语框架下，描述了七种反复出现的形态：LLM聊天、定制智能体、检索增强生成（RAG）、AI增强工作流、副驾驶、编码智能体，以及部分涉及智能体的RAG。 每种形态均沿四个结构维度进行特征描述（智能体增强RAG仅部分适用）：架构模式、执行控制与用户介入点、每任务智能体调用次数以及工具使用方式。 一个包含22个系统的示例语料库，这些系统来自研究论文和供应商文档，为上述描述提供了依据，并展示了它们各自的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have moved beyond their initial role as conversational assistants. They are used as components inside software systems, where their output is consumed not by a human reader but by other pieces of software. Embedded in a program, an LLM no longer serves only as a content generator: it selects actions, parametrizes external services, and influences what happens next.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经超越了其最初作为对话助手的功能。 它们被用作软件系统中的组件，其输出不再由人类读者接收，而是由其他软件模块使用。 当嵌入到程序中时，LLM 不再仅仅充当内容生成器：它会选择操作、配置外部服务的参数，并影响后续发生的事件。

sents.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经超越了其最初作为对话助手的功能。

paragraphs.en: A vocabulary for these systems has emerged along with them. Practitioners speak of chatbots, copilots, retrieval-augmented generation, workflows, AI agents and agentic AI, and vendors use the same terms in product names and branding. The terms are evidently useful, since they are used routinely and widely. What is missing is an account of what they denote: developer guides, engineering blogs and vendor material or product documentation describe what individual systems do, but rarely how they are built or how one form compares architecturally with another. LLM-integrated systems developed in research usually originate in an application domain, where this terminology is adopted rather than examined. Several of the terms appear to have been coined in the development and research laboratories of leading vendors and adopted by the academic literature afterward, rather than the reverse.
paragraphs.zh: 随着这些系统的出现，一套相关的术语也随之产生。 从业者会提到聊天机器人、副驾驶、检索增强生成、工作流、AI 智能体以及智能体式 AI，而供应商也会在产品名称和品牌宣传中使用相同的术语。 这些术语显然是有用的，因为它们被广泛且频繁地使用。 但缺失的是对这些术语所指内容的明确解释：开发者指南、工程博客以及供应商的资料或产品文档描述了各个系统的具体功能，却很少说明它们是如何构建的，或者不同形式在架构上如何比较。 研究领域中开发的集成 LLM 的系统通常源于某个具体应用领域，在这些领域，人们倾向于直接使用这些术语，而非对其含义进行审视。 其中一些术语似乎是在领先供应商的研发实验室中创造出来的，随后被学术文献所采用，而非相反的情况。

The result is a field that is hard to survey for newcomers and practitioners alike, and in which researchers struggle to position their work and compare it with related approaches.

paragraphs.en: Conceptual work published by vendors presents catalogues of architectural patterns intended as guidance for developers building LLM-based systems [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Surveys of multi-agent systems (MAS) address collaboration mechanisms [ 4 ] , application domains [ 5 ] , or the conceptual distinction between AI agents and agentic AI [ 6 ] . Masterman et al. and Zhou et al. classify agent systems as single- versus multi-agent and hierarchical versus decentralized architecture, but draw their examples from research prototypes [ 7 , 8 ] . None of these works characterizes applications systematically.
paragraphs.zh: 供应商发布的概念性研究提供了建筑模式的目录，旨在为构建基于大型语言模型（LLM）系统的开发者提供指导 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 关于多智能体系统（MAS）的综述探讨了协作机制 [ 4 ] 、应用领域 [ 5 ] ，或人工智能智能体与代理型人工智能之间的概念性区别 [ 6 ] 。 Masterman 等人以及 Zhou 等人将智能体系统分为单智能体与多智能体、分层与去中心化架构，但其示例均源自研究原型 [ 7 , 8 ] 。 这些研究中没有任何一项对应用进行了系统性描述。

paragraphs.en: In earlier work, the author proposed a taxonomy of LLM-integrated applications that characterizes the individual model invocation, termed LLM component, which corresponds to the notion of AI agent used in this paper. That approach decomposes LLM-integrated applications into LLM components and classifies each component along several dimensions [ 9 ] , but stops short of describing whole system architectures.

paragraphs.en: Closest to the present work is the taxonomy of Händler [ 10 ] , which classifies autonomous LLM-powered MAS by their levels of autonomy and alignment, assessed per architectural aspect. Its alignment axis is a finer-grained treatment of what appears here as user control; its autonomy axis is related to our number of agent calls per task. It covers one class of systems, applied to seven open-source projects, and includes a workflow automation tool expressly as a contrasting case; the present paper describes a broader range of forms in uniform terms. To the author’s knowledge, no other work describes the range of established forms in a single, common vocabulary at the level of application systems.
paragraphs.zh: 与本研究最接近的是 Händler [10] 的分类体系，该体系根据自主性程度和一致性水平，按架构维度对由 LLM 驱动的自主多智能体系统（MAS）进行分类。 其一致性维度更精细地处理了本文所称的用户控制问题；其自主性维度则与本文提出的每任务智能体调用次数相关。 该体系涵盖一类系统，并应用于七个开源项目，其中还明确将一种工作流自动化工具作为对比案例；而本文则以统一术语描述了更广泛的形式。 据作者所知，尚无其他研究能在应用系统层面，用单一通用词汇表来描述现有形式的完整范围。

paragraphs.en: An LLM is used by invoking it with a prompt, as shown in Fig. 1 . A prompt comprises several types of information: an instruction or system prompt, which defines the general behavior of the prompted LLM, such as “act as a helpful assistant”; a state or context part, which informs the LLM about the current circumstances, such as a dialog history; and the task it has to solve, such as a user’s question it has to answer [ 9 ] . An LLM cannot act; it can only produce text. Its scope is extended by giving it access to tools . The model uses a tool by emitting a call with parameters appropriate to the task; the surrounding system executes it, holding the function implementations, the service endpoints and credentials, or the execution environment for generated code, and the result is optionally fed into a further invocation from which the model formulates a response (Fig. 2 ).

paragraphs.en: This paper adheres to a minimal definition: an AI agent is a prompt-and-response system component, with or without access to tools. The term LLM agent would be more precise, but AI agent is adopted because it has become established and is consistent with the equally established term agentic AI . Under this definition, agents are the building blocks of agentic AI and of LLM-based software systems, i.e., systems that invoke LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 本文遵循一个最小定义：AI智能体是一个提示-响应系统组件，无论是否具备工具访问权限。 “LLM智能体”这一术语更为精确，但本文采用“AI智能体”，因为该术语已广泛确立，且与同样成熟的“代理型AI”术语保持一致。 根据这一定义，智能体是代理型AI和基于LLM的软件系统的基本构建单元，即调用LLM的系统。

paragraphs.en: What constitutes a given AI agent is its prompt, above all its instruction or system prompt. It defines the agent’s behavior, while the model that processes the prompt is in principle interchangeable. Agents can be designed with varying degrees of complexity. A multifunctional agent performs a range of functions, selects the appropriate one itself and decides on its execution; typically a whole palette of tools is at its disposal, which it selects and parametrizes autonomously. A monofunctional agent fulfils only a delimited function, for example parametrizing a single tool. There is a continuum from strictly monofunctional to multifunctional agents, rather than a strict division.
paragraphs.zh: 一个特定的 AI 智能体由它的提示构成，尤其是它的指令或系统提示。 它定义了智能体的行为，而处理该提示的模型原则上可以相互替换。 智能体可以被设计成具有不同复杂程度的版本。 多功能智能体能执行一系列功能，自行选择适当的功能并决定如何执行；通常它可以使用多种工具，并能自主选择和配置这些工具的参数。 单一功能智能体仅执行一个限定明确的功能，例如为单个工具配置参数。 智能体的类型并非严格划分为单一功能或多功能，而是存在一个从严格单一功能到多功能的连续谱。

paragraphs.en: LLM calls can be combined and integrated into systems in countless ways. Among these, certain basic architectures are—with varying names—described in the literature [ 1 , 7 , 8 , 3 ] . The following list names some of them.

paragraphs.en: Monofunctional single agent and multifunctional single agent (Fig. 1 ), which may include tool use, have been described in Section III . In the context of AI agents, the term workflow refers to applications in which the agents are embedded in a prescribed process. Workflows solve tasks over a sequence of process steps. Individual steps may be realized as agents, and the process supplies each agent invocation with data from the process context. The sequence is defined in advance and may contain conditional branches, but it is not composed dynamically by a model. A special case is the prompt-chaining workflow , consisting of a sequence of LLM calls, where the result of an LLM call is fed into the prompt of the next LLM call. The router-worker architecture consists of a central router agent and a set of specialized worker agents. A worker is a subagent, typically monofunctional. An input to the system first reaches the router, which determines which of the system’s predefined tasks the input matches—intent detection—and then invokes the worker agent responsible for the detected intent with parameters extracted from the system environment and the input.
paragraphs.zh: 单功能单一智能体和多功能单一智能体（图 1），后者可能包含工具使用，已在第三节中进行了描述。 在人工智能智能体的语境下，“工作流”一词指的是将智能体嵌入到预定流程中的应用。 工作流通过一系列流程步骤来完成任务。 各个步骤可以以智能体的形式实现，而流程则为每次智能体调用提供来自流程上下文的数据。 该序列是预先定义的，可能包含条件分支，但并非由模型动态生成。 一种特殊情况是提示链式工作流，它由一系列 LLM 调用组成，其中一次 LLM 调用的结果会被输入到下一次 LLM 调用的提示中。 路由-工作者架构由一个中央路由智能体和一组专门的工作者智能体组成。 工作者是一个子智能体，通常是单功能的。 系统首先接收输入并将其传递给路由器，路由器会判断该输入与系统中哪个预定义任务相匹配——即意图识别——然后调用负责该识别出的意图的工作者智能体，并传入从系统环境和输入中提取的参数。

paragraphs.en: In the orchestrator-worker architecture a central manager agent plans and steers. It decomposes a task into subtasks and hands them to specialized workers by configuring their prompts; workers may run in parallel, and a further agent may consolidate the partial results.
paragraphs.zh: 在协调器-工作者架构中，一个中央管理智能体负责规划和引导。 它将任务分解为子任务，并通过配置提示词将其分配给专门的工作者；这些工作者可以并行运行，另一个智能体还可以整合部分结果。

sents.zh: 在协调器-工作者架构中，一个中央管理智能体负责规划和引导。

paragraphs.en: The planner-executor architecture, also called manager-worker, adds iterative refinement. The planner produces a work plan, workers execute subtasks and additionally return feedback, and the planner revises the plan and delegates again until the desired result is reached. The hierarchical planner-executor variant inserts intermediate planners: a high-level planner performs coarse planning and passes subtasks to subordinate planners that refine them, with workers executing at the leaves. All architectures involving calls to workers or subagents have analogous hierarchical variants.
paragraphs.zh: 规划器-执行器架构，也称为管理-工作者架构，增加了迭代优化环节。 规划器生成工作计划，工作者执行子任务并返回反馈，随后规划器修订计划并再次分配任务，直至达到预期结果。 分层规划器-执行器变体引入了中间规划器：高层规划器进行粗略规划，将子任务交给下属规划器进行细化，而工作者则在底层节点执行任务。 所有涉及调用工作者或子智能体的架构都存在类似的分层变体。

paragraphs.en: In the reason-and-act (ReAct) loop , a single multifunctional agent interleaves reasoning with tool calls in a loop: it reasons about what to do next, invokes a tool, evaluates the result in a further reasoning step, and repeats until it judges the task complete [ 16 ] . If the ReAct agent’s tools include subagents, it constitutes a further MAS architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 在“推理-行动”（ReAct）循环中，单个多功能智能体将推理与工具调用交替进行：它先推理下一步该做什么，然后调用一个工具，在后续的推理步骤中评估结果，并重复这一过程，直到判断任务完成 [ 16 ]。 如果 ReAct 智能体的工具包含子智能体，则构成一种更进一步的 MAS 架构。

sents.en: In the reason-and-act (ReAct) loop , a single multifunctional agent interleaves reasoning with tool calls in a loop: it reasons about what to do next, invokes a tool, evaluates the result in a further reasoning step, and repeats until it judges the task complete [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: 在“推理-行动”（ReAct）循环中，单个多功能智能体将推理与工具调用交替进行：它先推理下一步该做什么，然后调用一个工具，在后续的推理步骤中评估结果，并重复这一过程，直到判断任务完成 [ 16 ]。

sents.zh: 如果 ReAct 智能体的工具包含子智能体，则构成一种更进一步的 MAS 架构。

paragraphs.en: These architectures vary in autonomy, that is, the degree of control left to an LLM within an agentic system. Some authors reserve the term autonomous MAS (AMAS) for architectures such as orchestrator-worker, reason-and-act, and planner-executor, where the number of LLM calls the MAS executes to fulfil a task is determined by an LLM rather than fixed, as in workflows or the router-worker architecture [ 1 ] . Agent systems may go further still, writing automation scripts and defining prompts for subagents by themselves, thereby attaining far-reaching autonomy [ 13 ] . Architectures without central control are also possible, notably peer-to-peer architectures in which agents divide the task among themselves and coordinate through mechanisms such as shared blackboards, voting or auctions. In practice, centrally controlled architectures dominate in 2025: among published case studies of deployed MAS on one framework platform, the orchestrator-worker and router-worker architectures are the most frequent [ 17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这些架构在自主性方面存在差异，即智能体系统内部留给 LLM 的控制程度。 一些作者将“自主多智能体系统”（AMAS）这一术语保留用于诸如协调器-工作者、推理-执行和规划器-执行器等架构，在这些架构中，多智能体系统为完成任务而执行的 LLM 调用次数由 LLM 决定，而非像工作流或路由器-工作者架构那样固定不变 [ 1 ]。 智能体系统还可以更进一步，自行编写自动化脚本并为子智能体定义提示，从而实现高度自主性 [ 13 ]。 没有中央控制的架构也是可能的，尤其是点对点架构，其中智能体在彼此之间分配任务，并通过共享黑板、投票或拍卖等机制进行协调。 实际上，2025 年以中央控制为主的架构占据主导地位：在已发布的关于某框架平台上部署的多智能体系统的案例研究中，协调器-工作者和路由器-工作者架构最为常见 [ 17 ]。

sents.zh: 这些架构在自主性方面存在差异，即智能体系统内部留给 LLM 的控制程度。

sents.en: Some authors reserve the term autonomous MAS (AMAS) for architectures such as orchestrator-worker, reason-and-act, and planner-executor, where the number of LLM calls the MAS executes to fulfil a task is determined by an LLM rather than fixed, as in workflows or the router-worker architecture [ 1 ] .
sents.zh: 一些作者将“自主多智能体系统”（AMAS）这一术语保留用于诸如协调器-工作者、推理-执行和规划器-执行器等架构，在这些架构中，多智能体系统为完成任务而执行的 LLM 调用次数由 LLM 决定，而非像工作流或路由器-工作者架构那样固定不变 [ 1 ]。

sents.en: Agent systems may go further still, writing automation scripts and defining prompts for subagents by themselves, thereby attaining far-reaching autonomy [ 13 ] .
sents.zh: 智能体系统还可以更进一步，自行编写自动化脚本并为子智能体定义提示，从而实现高度自主性 [ 13 ]。

sents.en: Architectures without central control are also possible, notably peer-to-peer architectures in which agents divide the task among themselves and coordinate through mechanisms such as shared blackboards, voting or auctions.
sents.zh: 没有中央控制的架构也是可能的，尤其是点对点架构，其中智能体在彼此之间分配任务，并通过共享黑板、投票或拍卖等机制进行协调。

sents.en: In practice, centrally controlled architectures dominate in 2025: among published case studies of deployed MAS on one framework platform, the orchestrator-worker and router-worker architectures are the most frequent [ 17 ] .
sents.zh: 实际上，2025 年以中央控制为主的架构占据主导地位：在已发布的关于某框架平台上部署的多智能体系统的案例研究中，协调器-工作者和路由器-工作者架构最为常见 [ 17 ]。

paragraphs.en: Agent systems may contain further agents that do not contribute to solving the task but supervise it. Guardrail agents, for example, check the inputs and outputs of other agents against safety rules, access rights or compliance requirements and block or modify actions that violate them [ 18 ] . Such agents are a cross-cutting concern, comparable to logging or authorization in conventional software: they can be added to any of the architectures listed above without altering it. They are therefore not treated here as architectural elements, and their invocations are not counted among the agent calls per task.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体系统可能包含其他智能体，这些智能体不直接参与任务解决，而是负责监督任务。 例如，护栏智能体会根据安全规则、访问权限或合规要求检查其他智能体的输入和输出，并阻止或修改违反这些规则的操作 [ 18 ] 。 这类智能体属于一种跨领域关注点，类似于传统软件中的日志记录或授权机制：它们可以添加到上述任何架构中，而无需改变原有架构。 因此，本文未将其视为架构元素，其调用次数也不计入每任务的智能体调用总数。

paragraphs.en: This section describes established forms of LLM-integrated applications by examples.
paragraphs.zh: 本节通过示例介绍了已成熟的 LLM 集成应用形式。

paragraphs.en: LLM chats offer a dialogue interface to a model. In organizations they are used for drafting texts of all kinds and for translation, and as a convenient and powerful substitute for search engines, with the known caveats that they occasionally produce fabricated information and that their knowledge does not extend to the present. Chat products typically work with multifunctional prompts, see for instance [ 19 ] . Users may request tool use explicitly, or the model decides for itself.
paragraphs.zh: LLM聊天功能为模型提供了一个对话界面。 在组织内部，它们被用于起草各类文本和翻译工作，也作为搜索引擎的一种便捷而强大的替代方案，但需要注意的是，它们偶尔会生成虚假信息，且其知识范围不包括当前信息。 聊天产品通常支持多功能提示，例如参见 [ 19 ] 。 用户可以明确要求使用工具，也可以由模型自行决定。

paragraphs.en: Effective prompts are often extensive and hard to develop, since small changes in wording can substantially change their effect. It therefore pays to store successful prompts for recurring tasks. Several AI chat platforms allow such prompts to be managed as custom agents in their interface, and vendor-independent platforms offer the same across models [ 21 ] . The names for custom agents differ by platform. Often, tools can be attached, and some services operate marketplaces in which custom agents are published and reused.
paragraphs.zh: 有效的提示通常篇幅较长且难以开发，因为措辞上的微小变化都可能显著改变其效果。 因此，将成功使用的提示保存下来以应对重复任务是值得的。 多个 AI 聊天平台允许在界面中将此类提示管理为自定义智能体，而跨模型兼容的平台也提供相同功能 [ 21 ] 。 不同平台对自定义智能体的命名方式各不相同。 通常可以附加相关工具，部分服务还运营着市场，用于发布和复用自定义智能体。

paragraphs.zh: 对定制智能体生态的分析发现，外部应用集成仍然相对罕见，大多数智能体都依赖宿主服务提供的功能 [ 22 ] ，而格式指南则建议将每个智能体的作用范围限定在某个边界明确的任务内 [ 23 ] 。 定制智能体也出现在更大型的系统内部：工作流会将其用作流程步骤 [ 24 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) [ 25 ] preserves the usability of the chat interface while opening knowledge sources that did not enter model training, such as an organization’s internal documents or specialized domain expertise. RAG retrieves passages from the knowledge sources to generate answers, which reduces fabrication (hallucination), and makes the supporting documents or entries explicit, so that an answer can be checked against them [ 26 , 27 ] . RAG is among the most successful applications of LLMs in professional settings. The following sections discuss two variants: RAG in the narrow sense, and agentic RAG.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）[ 25 ] 在保留聊天界面可用性的同时，能够利用模型训练时未包含的知识源，例如组织的内部文档或专业领域的专家知识。 RAG 会从知识源中检索相关段落以生成答案，这有助于减少编造内容（幻觉），并使支撑性文档或条目明确呈现，从而可以对答案进行验证 [ 26 , 27 ] 。 RAG 是大型语言模型（LLM）在专业领域中最成功的应用之一。 以下部分将讨论两种变体：狭义上的 RAG 和智能体式 RAG。

sents.en: The following sections discuss two variants: RAG in the narrow sense, and agentic RAG.
sents.zh: 以下部分将讨论两种变体：狭义上的 RAG 和智能体式 RAG。

paragraphs.en: RAG in the narrow sense goes back to [ 25 ] and is suited to large, heterogeneous and largely unstructured document collections, such as manuals, project reports or case records built up over years. In the form common today, the collection is prepared in advance: text is extracted from the source formats, split into chunks, converted into vectors by an embedding model and stored in a vector database. At query time, the same embedding model converts the user’s question into a vector, and the system retrieves the chunks whose vectors are most similar. These are inserted into the prompt, from which an LLM then generates the answer.
paragraphs.zh: 狭义上的 RAG 可追溯至 [ 25 ]，适用于大型、异构且基本非结构化的文档集合，例如手册、项目报告或多年积累的案例记录。 在如今常见的形式中，文档集合是预先准备好的：从源格式中提取文本，将其分割成片段，通过嵌入模型转换为向量，并存储在向量数据库中。 在查询时，相同的嵌入模型会将用户的问题转换为向量，系统则会检索出向量最相似的片段。 这些片段会被插入到提示中，随后 LLM 会基于该提示生成答案。

paragraphs.en: Agentic RAG denotes approaches for searching large and frequently changing content such as company websites, intranets, wikis, document collections or databases. Retrieval is performed by appropriate mechanisms invoked as tools, such as web search, enterprise search, and database queries [ 28 , 29 ] . In Agentic RAG, agents decide what to retrieve. Many architectures have been proposed [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] , ranging from single-agent loops with retrieval tools to multi-agent and hierarchical designs. Deep research systems are a special form of Agentic RAG [ 31 ] . A detailed study of the architectures of agentic RAG products [ 33 , 34 ] and deep research systems [ 35 , 36 , 15 ] is beyond the scope of this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式 RAG 指的是用于搜索大型且频繁变化的内容（例如公司网站、内网、维基、文档集合或数据库）的方法。 检索通过作为工具调用的适当机制完成，例如网络搜索、企业搜索和数据库查询 [ 28 , 29 ] 。 在智能体式 RAG 中，由智能体决定检索哪些内容。 已有许多架构被提出 [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] ，从包含检索工具的单一智能体循环到多智能体和分层设计不等。 深度研究系统是智能体式 RAG 的一种特殊形式 [ 31 ] 。 对智能体式 RAG 产品 [ 33 , 34 ] 和深度研究系统 [ 35 , 36 , 15 ] 的架构进行详细研究超出了本文的范围。

paragraphs.en: Besides denoting an architectural MAS pattern, the term workflow also denotes a class of software that predates the current wave of agentic AI: platforms for robotic process automation (RPA), workflow automation and business process management. The platforms target trained end users with low-code or no-code environments in which workflows are assembled by arranging and connecting prefabricated blocks in a graphical user interface. Many of these established platforms have been extended with blocks that invoke LLM agents; these agents are configured in dedicated agent-builder areas [ 37 , 38 ] . For instance, such agents draft replies to customer e-mails, summarize incoming messages or route them to the responsible staff member. One platform aimed at IT professionals makes agent invocations available as modeling elements within process models expressed in the standardized Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) [ 39 ] . Another is source-available, can be self-hosted and used with arbitrary models, including local ones, which helps to satisfy strict data protection requirements, for example in public administration [ 40 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 除了表示一种架构化的多智能体系统模式外，“工作流”一词也指一类早于当前智能体人工智能浪潮的软件：用于机器人流程自动化（RPA）、工作流自动化和业务流程管理的平台。 这些平台面向受过培训的最终用户，提供低代码或无代码环境，用户可以在图形用户界面中通过排列和连接预制模块来构建工作流。 许多这类成熟平台已经扩展了可调用大语言模型智能体的模块；这些智能体在专门的智能体构建区域中进行配置 [ 37 , 38 ] 。 例如，这类智能体能起草客户电子邮件的回复、总结收到的消息，或将消息转交给负责的工作人员。 一个面向 IT 专业人士的平台，将智能体调用作为建模元素，整合到采用标准化业务流程模型与表示法（BPMN）表达的流程模型中 [ 39 ] 。 另一个平台是开源的，可以自行托管并使用任意模型（包括本地模型），这有助于满足严格的数据保护要求，例如在公共管理部门 [ 40 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Copilot has become an established term for LLM-integrated systems. Our survey of commercial systems and research prototypes labeled copilots aims to identify their common characteristics. It draws on vendor documentation and, as this is often not very detailed, also on direct inspection of the systems and on the findings of an interview study with engineers building product copilots [ 45 ] . Table I summarizes the results.
paragraphs.zh: “Copilot”已成为集成大型语言模型（LLM）的系统的一个通用术语。 我们对被标记为“copilot”的商业系统和研究原型进行的调查，旨在识别它们的共同特征。 该调查参考了供应商的文档；由于这些文档通常不够详细，因此还直接检查了这些系统，并参考了与构建产品“copilot”的工程师进行访谈研究的结果 [45]。 表 I 总结了调查结果。

paragraphs.en: One office suite vendor describes an orchestration engine that combines the language model with the suite’s applications and the user’s business data, together with an extensible set of skills that the assistant applies [ 47 ] . The same source states that the user decides what to keep, modify or discard; an early demo video shows this behavior [ 46 ] . The same vendor’s copilot for CRM and ERP is likewise a set of delimited capabilities operating on the functions of the host applications: it drafts replies from case history and knowledge bases, curates customer segments in dialogue with the customer data platform, and generates product descriptions from stored item attributes [ 48 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一家办公套件供应商描述了一种编排引擎，它将语言模型与该套件的应用程序以及用户的业务数据相结合，并辅之以助手所应用的一整套可扩展技能 [ 47 ] 。 同一来源指出，由用户决定保留、修改或舍弃哪些内容；一段早期的演示视频展示了这一行为 [ 46 ] 。 该供应商为 CRM 和 ERP 提供的副驾驶工具同样是一组限定范围的功能，这些功能在主机应用程序的功能上运行：它能根据案例历史和知识库起草回复，在与客户数据平台的交互中整理客户细分，并基于存储的商品属性生成产品描述 [ 48 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In a further ERP suite the assistant contains workers that execute tasks directly; in the procurement module these create purchase requisitions, change purchase orders and so on, without the user opening the respective applications [ 49 ] . The worker set and the binding of each worker to its tools are thus documented capability by capability.
paragraphs.zh: 在另一个 ERP 套件中，助手包含直接执行任务的智能体；在采购模块中，这些智能体会创建采购申请、更改采购订单等，而无需用户打开相应的应用程序 [ 49 ]。 供应商的技术文档分别记录了这些功能中的每一项，并为其配备了独立的应用编程接口集以及独立的语义对象-动作对，这是该平台用于调用应用程序功能的既定方式。 因此，智能体集合以及每个智能体与其工具的绑定关系都按照各项功能逐一记录在文档中。

paragraphs.en: An industrial vendor develops copilots along the value chain, from design through engineering, planning, and operations to service. The architecture distinguishes between copilots and specialized agents: users interact with the copilot, while an orchestrator delegates tasks to specialized agents [ 56 ] . A demo shows the operations copilot being accessed via a chat interface [ 57 ] . Agents are described as understanding intent and accessing external tools and other agents; they create plans and execute actions independently [ 51 ] , while users retain full control and can select which tasks to delegate to them [ 56 ] . This indicates that the copilot implements a router-worker pattern at the level at which the user interacts with it, while the workers—though specialized—may themselves implement the orchestrator-worker pattern described in Section III-D .
paragraphs.zh: 一家工业供应商沿着价值链开发协作智能体，涵盖从设计、工程、规划、运营到服务的全流程。 该架构区分了协作智能体与专用智能体：用户与协作智能体交互，而协调器则将任务分配给专用智能体 [ 56 ] 。 一个演示展示了通过聊天界面访问运营协作智能体的过程 [ 57 ] 。 智能体被描述为能够理解意图并访问外部工具和其他智能体；它们能独立创建计划并执行操作 [ 51 ] ，而用户则保留完全控制权，可以选择将哪些任务委托给它们 [ 56 ] 。 这表明协作智能体在用户与其交互的层面上实现了路由-工作者模式，而工作者——尽管是专用的——本身可能也实现了第三部分 D 节中描述的协调器-工作者模式。

paragraphs.en: A prominent programming copilot product installs into development environments as a plug-in and uses their functions, e.g., for editing and creating files or writing test routines. Product screenshots show specialized copilot skills—the workers—which the user can invoke directly with a slash command, thereby bypassing the copilot’s intent detection [ 52 , 58 ] . In its FAQ, the vendor states the division of responsibility as a design principle, noting that the product is called copilot rather than autopilot and that generated code is not intended to be compiled or executed before the developer has reviewed it [ 52 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一款知名的编程智能体辅助产品以插件形式安装到开发环境中，并利用这些环境的功能，例如编辑和创建文件或编写测试程序。 产品截图展示了智能体辅助工具的专业技能——即“工作者”，用户可以直接通过斜杠命令调用它们，从而绕过智能体辅助工具的意图识别功能 [ 52 , 58 ] 。 在其常见问题解答中，该供应商将责任划分作为一项设计原则进行说明，指出该产品被称为“智能体辅助”而非“自动驾驶”，且生成的代码在开发者审查之前并不打算被编译或执行 [ 52 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A product configuration copilot provides a chat interface for a product configurator. It translates natural-language user input into a format the constraint resolver can process automatically, and phrases the results in natural language for the user [ 53 ] . This copilot operates an existing application, and the user can see and correct the effect of the operation immediately. With only one supported intent, the setup is too simple to require routing. An agricultural copilot operates an Agricultural Data Management and Analytics (ADMA) platform. Its controller agent infers the user’s intent, determines which of a platform’s tools and processing steps the intended analysis requires, parametrizes them, and coordinates their execution following a predefined meta-program graph [ 54 ] . This resembles the orchestrator-worker architecture of Subsection III-D more than the router-worker one.
paragraphs.zh: 产品配置协理员为产品配置器提供了一个聊天界面。 它将自然语言的用户输入转换为约束求解器可以自动处理的格式，并以自然语言的形式将结果呈现给用户 [ 53 ] 。 该协理员操作一个现有应用程序，用户能够立即看到并纠正操作所产生的效果。 由于仅支持一种意图，其设置过于简单，无需进行路由。 农业协理员操作一个农业数据管理与分析（ADMA）平台。 其控制器智能体可推断用户的意图，确定所需分析需要平台中的哪些工具和处理步骤，为其设置参数，并按照预定义的元程序图协调它们的执行 [ 54 ] 。 这与 III-D 小节的协调器-工作者架构更为相似，而非路由器-工作者架构。

paragraphs.en: A copilot for manufacturing equipment selection follows the router-worker pattern at the level at which the user interacts with it, while one of its workers is internally a workflow of successive model invocations: the suitability of a selection is checked by a further model invocation rather than by the user, who is consulted only when that check fails [ 55 ] . This copilot accesses knowledge, but does not operate further application software.
paragraphs.zh: 用于制造设备选择的副驾驶在用户与其交互的层面上遵循“路由器-工作者”模式，而其中一个工作者内部是一个由连续模型调用组成的工作流：某个选择的适宜性由另一次模型调用进行验证，而非由用户亲自判断；只有在验证失败时，才会向用户征求意见 [ 55 ] 。 该副驾驶可以访问知识，但不会进一步操作其他应用软件。

paragraphs.en: Typical copilots operate existing application software, visibly performing steps previously done by hand; commercial ones are frequently integrated directly into the host product. Architecturally, they follow a router-worker pattern: the user states a goal in a chat window, the copilot detects the intent, and specialized workers carry it out. Because the effect of each operation is visible, the user can keep it or refine it in further turns. Some copilots additionally propose contextually appropriate actions, for example as buttons triggering the corresponding intent.

paragraphs.en: Among the emerging forms of AMAS applications that share a common architecture are coding agents for software development. They are built around an agentic loop that delegates work to subagents [ 62 , 63 , 64 , 65 , 1 ] . A coding copilot (GitHub Copilot) has since been extended with an agent mode that follows the same pattern [ 61 ] .

paragraphs.en: A further AMAS example is Anthropic’s Research feature. Its developers describe it as a multi-agent architecture in which a lead agent analyzes the query, devises a research strategy and delegates subtasks to subagents that run in parallel, then synthesizes their findings and decides whether further research is needed; if so, it spawns additional subagents or revises its strategy [ 15 ] . Although its developers name it an orchestrator-worker AMAS, this comes close to the planner-executor pattern as defined in this paper. The correspondence is not exact: the subagents are themselves tool-using agents that search, evaluate intermediate results and reformulate their own queries, so they are considerably more autonomous than executors in the classical sense; and planning is interleaved with execution rather than completed up front.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个 AMAS 的例子是 Anthropic 的“研究”功能。 其开发者将其描述为一种多智能体架构：一个主智能体分析查询、制定研究策略，并将子任务分配给并行运行的子智能体，然后综合它们的发现并判断是否需要进一步研究；如果需要，它会创建额外的子智能体或调整策略 [15]。 尽管其开发者称其为“协调者-工作者”型 AMAS，但它与本文所定义的“规划者-执行者”模式非常接近。 这种对应关系并不完全一致：子智能体本身是使用工具的智能体，能够搜索、评估中间结果并重新构建自己的查询，因此它们比传统意义上的执行者具有更高的自主性；此外，规划与执行是交替进行的，而非在开始前就完成全部规划。

paragraphs.en: This study asks which structurally similar forms of LLM-integrated systems have already emerged, given that interest in and development of these systems began less than four years before this study. It investigates whether the labels applied to LLM-integrated systems denote actual forms beyond mere branding, and, where they do, what characteristics constitute each label. The study focuses on structural dimensions to characterize the systems, including system architecture, degree of user control, number of agent calls per task, and tool use, as such characteristics make it possible to describe newly developed systems in new application areas.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于对这些系统的兴趣和研究始于本研究开始不到四年前，本研究旨在探讨结构相似的 LLM 集成系统已出现了哪些形式。 本研究旨在探究用于描述 LLM 集成系统的标签是否代表了超越单纯品牌命名的实际形式；如果确实如此，那么哪些特征构成了每个标签。 本研究聚焦于系统的结构性维度以对其进行描述，包括系统架构、用户控制程度、每任务智能体调用次数以及工具使用，因为这些特征使得能够在新应用领域中描述新开发的系统成为可能。

paragraphs.en: The study does not aim to provide a taxonomy that sorts systems into separate, mutually exclusive categories, nor to map a fine-grained design space for developers or to serve as an analytical instrument for detailed architectural research. It characterizes LLM-integrated systems at a general level, which is what its purpose requires: to provide an accessible framework for practitioners, students, and newcomers to the field, and to help position and label systems using established, common terms.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究并不旨在提供一个将系统划分为彼此独立、互斥类别的分类体系，也不为开发者绘制精细的设计空间，或作为详细架构研究的分析工具。 它在一般层面上描述了集成 LLM 的系统，这正是其目的所需：为从业者、学生以及该领域的新人提供一个易于理解的框架，并借助既定的通用术语来定位和标注这些系统。

paragraphs.en: The survey indicates that vendors use the label copilot consistently, as detailed in Section IV-E . The subsequent shift to agent is accordingly more than a change in fashion, as it marks a move from AI-selected single steps that the user confirms to AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The survey also found that the coding agents of four major providers are similar along the structural dimensions examined. For RAG in the narrow sense, the characteristics were derived from the original formulation [ 25 ] ; the survey did not investigate to what extent products or prototypes branded as RAG exist and conform to this definition. The study introduces its own label, AI-enhanced workflow, to the author’s knowledge there is not yet a common label for this form.
paragraphs.zh: 调查显示，供应商始终使用“copilot”这一标签，具体细节见第四节E部分。 因此，随后向“智能体”的转变不仅仅是潮流的变化，因为它标志着从用户确认的AI选择的单步操作，转向用户仅能看到结果的AI规划的多步骤执行。 调查还发现，四大供应商的编码智能体在所考察的结构维度上具有相似性。 对于狭义上的RAG，其特性源自最初的定义[25]；该调查并未研究被标记为RAG的产品或原型在多大程度上存在并符合这一定义。 据作者所知，本研究引入了自己的标签“AI增强型工作流程”，因为目前尚无通用标签来指代这一形式。

sents.zh: 多样化、混合型和嵌套式架构都是可能且常见的。

paragraphs.en: The Equipment Selection Copilot [ 55 ] is an example: at the level the user interacts with, it is a router-worker copilot, but one of its workers is internally a workflow of several chained model invocations.
paragraphs.zh: 设备选择副驾驶 [ 55 ] 就是一个例子：在用户交互的层面上，它是一个路由器-工作者副驾驶，但其其中一个工作者内部实际上是由多个串联模型调用组成的工作流。

paragraphs.en: As agentic systems become more common, more such nested architectures are expected to appear, as copilot-type and chat-type systems become enhanced with MAS-type workers and tools. The chat or copilot pattern acts at the user-interface level, which starts the agentic workers or tools autonomously, in cooperation with, or with confirmation from, the user. For these cases, it is suggested that the classification be drawn at the user-facing level, with the internal nesting recorded as a property of the respective workers, rather than treated as a separate system form.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体系统的日益普及，预计会出现更多此类嵌套架构，因为副驾驶型和聊天型系统将通过集成多智能体系统（MAS）类型的执行器和工具得到增强。 聊天或副驾驶模式在用户界面层面运作，它会自主启动智能体执行器或工具，并与用户合作或在用户确认的情况下运行。 在这些情况下，建议将分类界限划定在面向用户的层面，而将内部嵌套记录为相应执行器的属性，而不是将其视为一种独立的系统形式。

paragraphs.en: Systems were characterized by a single author from published descriptions; for several commercial systems, these, necessarily, are vendor sources that disclose only a certain level of technical detail; in some cases, the characterization is based only on what the vendor states. The corpus is illustrative rather than representative, and no frequency claims follow from it. Independent second coding, and characterization against technical rather than promotional sources where these become available, would strengthen the observations.
paragraphs.zh: 系统的特征由单一作者根据已发表的描述进行界定；对于若干商业系统而言，这些描述必然来自供应商提供的资料，而此类资料仅披露特定程度的技术细节；在某些情况下，特征的界定完全基于供应商的陈述。 该语料库具有说明性而非代表性，因此不能据此得出任何关于频率的结论。 若能对语料进行独立的二次编码，并在有可用资料的情况下，依据技术来源而非宣传材料来界定特征，则上述观察结果将更具说服力。

sents.zh: 系统的特征由单一作者根据已发表的描述进行界定；对于若干商业系统而言，这些描述必然来自供应商提供的资料，而此类资料仅披露特定程度的技术细节；在某些情况下，特征的界定完全基于供应商的陈述。

sents.en: The corpus is illustrative rather than representative, and no frequency claims follow from it.
sents.zh: 该语料库具有说明性而非代表性，因此不能据此得出任何关于频率的结论。

sents.en: Independent second coding, and characterization against technical rather than promotional sources where these become available, would strengthen the observations.
sents.zh: 若能对语料进行独立的二次编码，并在有可用资料的情况下，依据技术来源而非宣传材料来界定特征，则上述观察结果将更具说服力。

paragraphs.en: The descriptions were developed over a period in which the field changed substantially: products marketed as copilots acquired capabilities now marketed as agents, and AMAS moved from research prototypes to commercial offerings. New forms of LLM-integrated systems keep emerging, for example locally hosted, user-configurable personal assistants that read and write files, run commands, and browse the web on the user’s own machine [ 66 ] . Extending the study to such new forms, and to further existing forms such as Deep Research and Agentic RAG, is a natural direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 这些描述是在该领域发生巨大变化的时期内逐步形成的：作为“副驾驶”营销的产品获得了如今被称为“智能体”的能力，而 AMAS 也从研究原型演变为商业化产品。 新型集成 LLM 的系统不断涌现，例如本地托管、用户可配置的个人助手，它们能够读取和写入文件、执行命令，并在用户的个人设备上浏览网页 [ 66 ] 。 将研究范围扩展到这些新形式，以及 Deep Research 和 Agentic RAG 等更多现有形式，是未来工作的一个自然方向。

paragraphs.en: Matching forms of LLM-integrated systems to other kinds of AI-based system not built on LLMs could help clarify their relation to the more recent forms of agentic AI; transactional chatbots [ 67 ] and the expert systems of the 1990s [ 68 ] are two examples.
paragraphs.zh: 将集成 LLM 的系统形式与那些未基于 LLM 构建的其他类型人工智能系统相匹配，可能有助于阐明它们与近期智能体形式的人工智能之间的关系；交易型聊天机器人 [ 67 ] 和 20 世纪 90 年代的专家系统 [ 68 ] 就是两个例子。

paragraphs.en: Many terms for LLM-integrated systems—chat, custom agent, agentic RAG, RAG, copilot, coding agent, etc.—are applied routinely in practice but have, with exception of RAG, not been described in the research literature in a way that states uniformly how the systems behind them are built.
paragraphs.zh: 许多与大型语言模型（LLM）集成的系统术语——例如聊天、自定义智能体、智能体式 RAG、RAG、副驾驶、编码智能体等——在实践中被频繁使用，但除了 RAG 之外，这些术语在研究文献中尚未得到统一描述，即尚未明确说明其背后系统的构建方式。

paragraphs.en: This paper has described six forms of such systems in full, and a seventh in part, illustrated by a survey of 22 systems characterized from vendor sources, own inspection, and video material, and informed by research publications, survey papers, and other secondary sources. Each form is characterized by its architecture, by the role left to the human user, by the number of agent calls per task, and by the tools its agents use.
paragraphs.zh: 本文完整描述了此类系统的六种形式，并部分描述了第七种形式；这些描述通过一项涵盖22个系统的研究得以说明，这些系统是从供应商资料、实地考察和视频材料中识别出来的，并参考了研究论文、综述文章和其他二手资料。 每种形式都以其架构、留给人类用户的角色、每个任务所需的智能体调用次数以及其智能体所使用的工具为特征。

paragraphs.en: The classification is offered as a means of relating these systems to one another: to make the field more accessible for newcomers and in teaching, to give practitioners a basis for comparing technologies, and – as a theoretical and conceptual contribution—to introduce the emerging terminology into the research literature so that studies can refer to it.
paragraphs.zh: 提出这种分类，旨在将这些系统相互关联：一方面，使该领域对初学者更易于理解，并有助于教学；另一方面，为从业者提供比较不同技术的基础；此外，作为一种理论和概念上的贡献，此举还能将新兴术语引入研究文献中，以便相关研究能够引用这些术语。
